părallēlus , a, um, and părallēlos , on, adj., = παράλληλος,
I.paraliel: “parallelos linea,” Vitr. 5, 8 : circuli paralleli; or absol. paralleli, concentric circles on the celestial globe, parallels of latitude: nostri circulos appellavere, Graeci parallelos, Plin. 6, 33, 39, § 212; Mart. Cap. 8, § 817.
From A Latin Dictionary (Charlton T. Lewis, Charles Short, Oxford, Clarendon Press, 1879)
